Primary request: orthographic closeup of dry compact mineral regolith, fine taupe sand, subtle ochre dust, sparse small angular gray silicate chips, subtle wind abrasion. Covers 2 metres square. Flat diffuse albedo, even brightness across whole image, fine detailed realistic grain, restrained contrast, no baked shadows or highlights, no horizon, props, text, border, watermarks, vegetation or large recognizable repeating features. Seamlessly repeatable on all edges.

Generate orthographic 2 metre square surface of exposed weathered sedimentary silicate bedrock, taupe gray stone with muted ochre mineral seams, fine irregular fractures, broad subtle compressed strata, sparse embedded grains. Flat diffuse albedo with no baked shadows, ambient occlusion or specular lighting. Uniform scale and brightness edge to edge, seamlessly repeating, restrained contrast. No objects, crystals, horizon, text, borders or vegetation. Detailed natural geology, not lava or stylized noise.
